authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't turn the list into a generic Grixis turbo-Breach shell that ignores the cascade engine.
Don't add expensive cascade hits that brick (Blood for the Blood God! deferred by the source).
Don't label it cEDH just because it contains a cEDH-capable combo.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Abaddon is not on the battlefield, so nothing cascades.
mitigations: Breach combo is commander-independent
Free counters protect him

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Too little life loss this turn leaves high-MV spells without cascade.
mitigations: Cheap pingers and drains before the main spell
Neheb converts life loss into mana

blueprint_failure_modes.description: A 0-MV cascade randomizes the library and can bottom a tutored card.
mitigations: Sequence top-of-library tutors after 0-MV casts

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Too many expensive cascade payoffs make hands slow and random.
mitigations: Keep the payoff count near the current 7

value.interaction: Heavy free/cheap stack interaction (8 counters/pitch spells) to force through the engine or the Breach turn; light board removal.
value.mana: Fast mana and rituals (Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, Ancient Tomb) to cast a five-drop early and still hold up spells; 30+ lands-equivalent with rocks.
value.protection: Abaddon has no built-in protection; the free counters double as protection; recasting at 7+ mana is slow.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Abaddon is the cascade engine: without him, hand-cast spells get no cascade and the exile-cast payoffs (Prosper, Nalfeshnee, Keeper of Secrets, Passionate Archaeologist) mostly go quiet. The Breach line works without him.
accepted_role.honest_note: The threshold resets every turn and only counts life opponents actually lost this turn, so the engine is turn-local and five mana; the Breach combo is the faster kill and is commander-independent.
